record_note: Wired by hand on 2026-09-18 (commit 3ee8251, 'ci: local gate runner + git hooks (no GitHub); format drift fixed; tidy clean'), before the kit existed as a git repo — so `revision` is the kit's FIRST PUBLISHED commit, not the exact copy point; do not read it as the tree this repo was copied from. The direction here is the reverse of the other recorded repos': JSOM's gate is one of the three real instances the kit's templates were generalised FROM (DESIGN-NOTES.md section 1 — the 2026-09-19 MoA design pass carried 'JSOM's tools/ci.sh + both hooks + .ci.env.example' verbatim in its prompt), and the only kit-to-repo traffic since is the tidy-baseline fix ported in 67302cc (card t_1eab5d69, already applied to all four files below). Synced on 2026-09-20 by card t_d899b8ff (the commit that carries this hash update): the four gate-contract rules this script used to predate — a final GATE PASSED/GATE FAILED token (it used to print only 'all N stage(s) passed in Xs'), BLOCK lines for every requested stage that did not run, export NO_COLOR=1 (this script greps tool output, and ANSI escapes defeat the greps), and a derived rather than hard-coded usage header range (was sed -n '2,21p') — plus the end-of-run summary the kit and jsonTools both print. files.adapted_why: This file is the kit template's ancestor, not an instance of it (525 lines vs 634), and it stays specialised on purpose: only CI_JOBS/CI_BUILD_DIR/CI_ASAN_BUILD_DIR/CI_FUZZ_SECONDS/CI_LOG_DIR/CI_STRICT_TOOLS/CI_KEEP_TMP/CI_DEFAULT_STAGES/CI_TIDY_BASELINE are knobs, the build dirs and the test command are hard-coded, there is no version stage, and it adds four stages the template does not have (fuzz, std, cli, conform) plus opt-in coverage — a sync must not force the template's parameterisation or stage set onto it. The template's tidy-baseline fix (tidy_key applied to both operands, plus --write-tidy-baseline) is already here via 67302cc, so that divergence is not lag; the four gate-contract rules it used to lack (verdict token, BLOCK lines, NO_COLOR, derived usage range) came in with t_d899b8ff on 2026-09-20, so every divergence left is deliberate.
